node.statement: Lower-modulus inference only: for x in R^k, node 1.1 and ||Upsilon Delta-I_B||_cb<=K*eta imply ||Delta iota_C x|| >= ||Upsilon Delta iota_C x|| >= (1-K*eta)||x||_inf. Node 1.3 gives ||Delta iota_C x-Phi Delta iota_C x||<=2K*eta||x||_inf, and ||Phi Delta iota_C x||=||J Q_C A x||<=||A x||_inf by contractivity of Q_C and isometry of J. Therefore ||A x||_inf >= (1-3K*eta)||x||_inf.
